title: Npcs
description: Authoring surface for named NPCs. Sourced from docs/design/npc-voices.md and npc-voices-batch2.md.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; must be unique.

factionId.description: FactionId enum name (cross-ref to factions.json). Omit for unaffiliated NPCs.

homeZoneId.description: Cross-ref to zones.json zoneId — the NPC's primary location.

voiceTells.description: Distinctive behavioral tells, drawn verbatim from the npc-voices design docs.

dialogueRootId.description: Optional id of the root dialogue node (future dialogue-tree integration). At most one per NPC.

startingReputation.description: Optional reputation offset applied when the player first contacts this NPC's faction.
